# Paslen Studio

> Paslen is a Pomodoro timer for Android. Its look (colors, digits, dial ticks) is described by a "vibe" JSON object.

## Vibes

- [Vibe JSON schema]({{ '/vibes/schema.txt' | absolute_url }}): full schema, field ranges, rules and an example — read this before writing a vibe
- [Formal JSON Schema]({{ '/vibes/schema.json' | absolute_url }}): draft 2020-12 schema for validation
- [Vibe catalogue]({{ '/vibes/' | absolute_url }}): ready-made vibes
{%- assign vibes = site.vibes | sort: "order", "last" %}
{%- for vibe in vibes %}
  - [{{ vibe.title }}]({{ vibe.url | absolute_url }})
{%- endfor %}

## Apps

- [Paslen timer on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.alki.paslen)
